3.1.3.1-r2.burton_quote: This love causeth true and absolute virtues, the life, spirit, and root of every virtuous action

3.1.3.1-r3.burton_quote: That other love infects the soul of man, this cleanseth; that depresses, this arears; that causeth cares and troubles, this quietness of mind; this informs, that deforms our life

3.1.3.1-r4.burton_quote: eternize his own name, to be immortal by the benefit of Scholars; for when his friends were dead, walls decayed, and all Inscriptions gone, books would remain to the world’s end
3.1.3.1-r4.translation: with a kind of undying, glorious desire; walls, even if built at a king's expense
